englishTranslation: Fine rice vermicelli sheets with grilled pork
atAGlance: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng is fine rice-noodle sheets with grilled pork, usually with scallion oil, herbs, rice paper, and fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng pairs delicate woven rice-noodle sheets with grilled pork, scallion oil, herbs, rice paper, and fish-sauce dip. It is often eaten as small wrapped bites.
howToEnjoy: Use rice paper if it is served: layer bánh hỏi, grilled pork, herbs, and cucumber, then dip lightly in the fish-sauce dip. The noodle sheets are delicate, so do not drown them.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh hỏi thịt nướng when you want a roll-your-own grilled pork plate. Ask for extra rice paper, extra herbs, or no chili in the fish-sauce dip before everyone starts wrapping.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, bánh hỏi makes grilled pork feel elegant: tiny noodle sheets carry scallion oil, smoke, herbs, and fish-sauce brightness in one bite.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh hỏi thịt nướng.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of fine rice vermicelli sheets with grilled pork.
